breakdown.description: Counterflow configuration is stated but the parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences are used.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the core inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly mixed a counterflow configuration with parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences. The ground truth corrects this by providing the proper counterflow temperature differences (ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,out and ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,in). The generated specification repeated the user's original error verbatim, stating to 'Use parallel-flow LMTD formula with ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,in and ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,out'.
